about: The graph spec's library operations (editor spec §51, spec_library_api). Each is in both libraries: the JavaScript name is read from packages/graph-spec/src/graph-spec-check.js, the Python one is module.name in python/graph_spec/src. 'required' is how many arguments a call must give; the rest have defaults. A problem is a ProfileError: JavaScript names its fields line, msg, fix, at and code; Python names them line, message, fix, at and code. Its code is in packages/graph-spec/src/reader/problem-codes.json, and a code is never reused. test/public-api.test.js and python/graph_spec/tests/test_library_api.py hold both libraries to this file.

problem.never_reused: A code is never reused or renumbered. A problem that goes keeps its code in 'retired'. A code's place in the spec and the parts its message and fix fill in ({name}) never change.
